description:
There is great potential in every ship with a skilled pilot at the helm. There is even more potential when enemies underestimate the vessel’s capabilities. GS-31 is living proof of this idea. After the events of the Alpha Team’s mission to prevent the Godsend from reaching the Terran Empire, Section 31 took a special interest in repurposing mundane vessels into their undercover units, aimed at providing inconspicuous transportation capable of dealing massive damage to unsuspecting foes. 
With the need to retrofit ships not intended to be used in the heat of the battle, the engineers of Section 31 decided to adapt the existing functionalities and enhance them to their maximum potential. Seeing how the Alpha team used the limited abilities of a garbage scow to overpower a fully functional battleship, GS-31 was equipped with an enhanced and improved tractor beam capable of a charged gravitational blast, damaging several hostile weapons at once. Thick and reinforced hull plates designed to protect the ship from stray rubble pieces provide the ultimate defense against incoming fire, and high-precision phasers can penetrate even the most intricate shields, tearing the foe’s barriers to shreds.
GS-31 is a great example of an unassuming appearance hiding endless potential. It is a perfect vessel for Section 31 agents attempting to hide in plain sight and strike the enemies of the Federation without attracting unwanted attention.
